newsitem.title: USA: Borg-Warner Auto wins Chrysler contract.
newsitem.headline: Borg-Warner Auto wins Chrysler contract.

text.p: Borg-Warner Automotive Inc said Friday it has been selected to design and produce a complete engine timing chain system for Chrysler Corp's new overhead cam 4.7 liter V8 engine.
The value of the contract was not immediately available but Borg-Warner said the program represents "significant additional business with Chrysler."
Borg-Warner expects to begin producing the timing sytems in late 1998 with volumes expected to eventually reach 425,000 units annually, the company said in a statement.
This is Borg-Warner's second program with Chrysler to provide a new timing chain system for a new overhead cam engine.
The new engine timing chain system will be made at Borg-Warner's Morse TEC Ithaca, N.Y. facility.
Borg-Warner supplies engineered components and systems to automakers. Shares were trading unchanged at 39-5/8.
